title: Mitosis architecture audit and rebuild exploration

completion_criteria.text: Foundational audit of the current engine complete across all four domains: two-layer fan-out, durability/resume, cost/latency, pipeline rigidity + fragility
External research verdict delivered on whether the architecture is correct, with disconfirming pass and cited prior art
The child_process runtime-capability question settled empirically (does dynamic import of node:child_process EXECUTE inside a Workflow script, not merely resolve)

Three open architecture decisions resolved by the user: adopt an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime vs only its state model; default speculation depth given that rework costs tokens not machine time; which work-type pipelines to define first
An approved architecture spec for the rebuild exists, superseding or explicitly scoping the six paused repair-oriented mitosis threads

spine.active_goal: Both MSPs shipped and merged: M2 as e7e4025 (PR #26) and A7 as 5dd7176 (PR #27), main green at both. Suite 1820/1820, coverage gate ok on all 12 ids at each landing. Gap 2 is resolved and was proven live - the census halted on divergence.mjs and refused green until its row landed. Gap 1 is NOT resolved: A3 and A5 characterization tests are owed and A2 is held. M2 is delivered as reshaped, since 0164 refuted its monotone-status comparator. Decisions 0172, 0173 and 0174 record it.
spine.next_step: Per 0174, in a FRESH session. (1) Run the A2 section 3.1 check - read-only; it admits or kills 0162's last held Gap 1 item. (2) Re-ground M6's preconditions against today's main: hermeticity, the guard fix on fix/guard-any-claude-root, the cite mapping. They live in the non-stop-shipping thread and predate several merges. (3) Dispatch M6 - durable run-identity manifest ref (spec 3.5), engine plus SKILL.md. Do NOT start M3.
open_risks: M6's recorded preconditions were NOT verified this session. They live in the non-stop-shipping thread and predate several merges; re-ground hermeticity, the guard fix on fix/guard-any-claude-root, and the cite mapping against today's main before dispatching M6.

A3 and A5 characterization tests are owed before M3 and M5 respectively (0162). M3 deletes runReconcileOnlyAdvance (0161), so starting M3 without A3's test deletes unpinned behaviour and forfeits why those tests were ratified.
A2 is HELD pending the section 3.1 check of its M2 claim (0162). A4 and A6 are dropped. Gap 1 is therefore NOT closed, even though A7 shipped.

B6 ships threatened on divergence.mjs by construction and by ratified decision 0173: no production importer is possible, since mitosis.js runs in a sandbox that denies import, so dead-export lint reads the twin's own copied text as liveness.
The plan's anchors for the A7 region are stale by 55 lines - it cites :2920 and :2934-2975. PR #27's M5 row names this and does not fix it, so the next reader of plan section 5.2 will be misled.

0171 follow-up still owed: D5's bare catch in workflow-body position swallows a tagged SandboxViolationError from the log sink. The second-channel design 0169 deferred must decide whether it is RE-THROWN. Now shipped on main.
Found, NOT fixed, needs its own record: relaunchStateFor seeds 'awaiting' for any id in runOpenPRs.accepted, and classifyRunOpenPRs accepts a PR whose unit is built OR parked. Pre-existing.

Coverage-filename convention drifted one entry: fix-m2-monotone-status.json landed from branch fix/m2-monotone-status-onto-main, and its M1 row's sentence about the branch name is now stale. The gate keys on registry-id completeness, so it passes.
A PR's scope is FROZEN at creation; title/body edits are denied. Push once BEFORE opening (0141); later facts go in a PR comment (0142). Titles cap at 72 chars. Merge stays human-gated.
NEVER invoke the compiled workflow. compileWorkflow returns a frozen async callable that would dispatch REAL agents. mitosis.js is read and edited as TEXT only.

The suite runner is `npm test` (package.json:7); `node --test <dir>` fails MODULE_NOT_FOUND on node v26.4.0. It takes about 7 seconds, so run it. .githooks/pre-commit runs it on every commit but NOT on cherry-pick.

A negative result from a hand-rolled shell check deserves suspicion before the code does: a malformed BSD-sed and zsh-glob one-liner reported a false byte-identity failure this session. Re-run it in node before believing it.
Landing stays SERIAL for anything touching mitosis.js or the mirror-guard census; a policed-twin edit lands in BOTH copies in one commit. Parallelize investigation, never landing.

ORCHESTRATION: never put an agent that switches branches in the same phase as one reading the working tree. Cut the branch in the main thread first, then dispatch. Every write under .claude/{hooks,rules,lib,workflows} needs per-write human approval.

17 worktree entries remain live; the reaper verb does not exist. Five pre-existing dirty paths (.claude/settings.json, .zshrc, two .bak files, .claude/skills/context7-mcp/) - stage explicit paths only, NEVER git add -A. Two stashes at depth 2. Three merged branches are deletable on confirmation.
out_of_scope: Any change at mitosis.js:4058-4061. H-C is REFUTED by 0159, not deferred - the done-union is correct and narrowing it is a liveness regression. Re-opening needs new evidence of an unconfirmed-ship producer.
Removing or weakening the veto at mitosis.js:3787. It is the resurrection guard (0160); frontier-train-e2e.test.mjs:578 forbids it. M2 names and logs it, nothing more.
Un-ignoring docs/superpowers/plans/ wholesale, and git add -f as the tracking mechanism - both rejected by 0158 in favour of the /* plus negation form.
Track A / continuity-ledger-plugin until all mitosis MSPs are delivered (0136). A-1, A-2, A-3 and the Track A half of Wave 0 are DEFERRED, not abandoned.
Any further B-6 work. Implemented, merged and green; the invariant is discharged. Re-opening needs a new reason, not a re-read.
Rewriting the specs' 78 anchors as a standalone effort - rejected by 0148. Re-baseline by execution per MSP instead.
Executing run-readiness-repair's MSP-0..MSP-10. Quiescent-advance M0..M8 lands first, and the overlap (M0/M1 against MSP-6/MSP-7) must be reconciled before that spec is scheduled.
Pipelines for refactor, perf, docs or chore - closed by 0118. Limits PIPELINES only, not the PR title type vocabulary.
The feat pipeline - 0110 sequences it second, after the fix pipeline proves the effector boundary.
Speculation depth above 1 - 0109 requires a restack proven for the fix work type first.
Bootstrapping a target repo's test infrastructure as a side effect of shipping - closed by 0117; that is verify-setup, human-invoked.
Adopting an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime - closed by 0108. A webhook, server or daemon for the relaunch trigger - closed by 0119.
fileScope-only task-edge derivation - rejected by 0116, settled by 0120.
Cluster-aware scheduling and the journal's 2000-char model-output paging - fenced out by spec section 1.
Dispatching or restarting any target-repo mitosis run.
Opening a pull request for docs/mitosis-core-rebuild-spec - the user ruled on 2026-07-30 that leaving it without a PR is fine.
The 12 leaked worktrees, the Step 0 reaper, and the two parked stashes.
